data.title: B2B Corporate Site
data.tagline: Build confidence through stable structure, concrete evidence, and real business context
data.description: A B2B corporate site is a website type for organizational buying, not a fixed visual style. It often supports a longer decision involving several people, so clear navigation, industry context, customer stories, compliance, and service information must work together to establish trust. The visual language can feel powerful, but every ambitious claim needs evidence from data, a case, or a real product capability.

use: B2B software, industry, finance, and professional services where trust matters more than impulse
Products serving several industries or roles that require durable navigation for complex content
Purchases involving several stakeholders , where cases, security, and support need equal visibility
Brands operating across markets that need a layout system able to scale across languages and business lines
avoid: Rely on grand claims : leading, empowering, and transforming say little without evidence
Turn the homepage into an org chart ; internal departments are not the customer's problem-solving path
Put every section in a dark blue box ; order creates professionalism, not one color alone
Treat a logo wall as a complete case study ; explain the problem, work, and understandable outcome

data.agentPrompt: B2B corporate website, stable grid and clear multi-level navigation, deep navy and warm white palette, authentic industry photography, specific metrics, customer stories, security certification and service capability, restrained and premium without generic corporate stock imagery
